comparison.objective: Find and fully reseat a half-inserted switch plug without disturbing neighboring live plugs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual fault identification and precise cable-plug insertion in a crowded panel.
comparison.success_condition: Loose plug reaches required depth, other plugs never unseat, and hands release.
comparison.reason: It tests connector insertion depth and neighbor preservation, not rotational setting, countertorque locking, or repeated actuation.
